title: Todd Bishop, Key players: Elvin Jones (Cruise Ship Drummer)
notes: 'He has a polyrhythm built into his playing, with an omnipresent 3/4 and 6/8 cross rhythm'; phrasing in 3/4 over 4/4.

title: Learn Jazz Standards: Trading fours like Elvin Jones, style and analysis
notes: 3/4 and 5/4 phrases on top of the 4/4 bar; landing on the second (middle) triplet; Anthropology from Dear John C.

title: Learn Jazz Standards: How to comp on the drums like Elvin Jones
notes: Odd accent placing; phrases starting and ending on beats 2 or 4 so often 'it would create the illusion that the metric of the tune had changed'.

title: Afro Blue - Wikipedia
notes: Jones superimposed two cross-beats over every measure of a 3/4 waltz (2:3) on Coltrane's 1963 recording.
